hero.badge: GDPR compliance operating system · European Union
hero.subheadline: Custodia replaces the spreadsheets, shared drives and ad-hoc consultant retainers that most EU businesses call a compliance programme. Records, assessments, vendors, data subject requests, consent and breaches — governed in one place, with an audit trail regulators accept.
hero.note: No card. No sales call. 12 minutes.

pains.title: Compliance fails quietly — in the gap between tools.
pains.subheadline: Three failure modes account for nearly every finding an EU supervisory authority raises.

modules.title: Eight modules, one register, one audit trail.
modules.subheadline: Every module writes to the same record of processing. Change a vendor, and the ROPA, the transfer assessment and the affected DSAR workflows update with it.

advisor.title: Answers with citations, not confident guesses.
advisor.subheadline: The advisor retrieves from a maintained legal corpus before it answers. Every response is grounded in a named source with a paragraph reference, so your DPO can verify the reasoning and your client can see the basis for it.
advisor.quote: Retrieval is scoped to the jurisdiction of the entity you are working in — a question asked inside a French client returns CNIL positions, not a generalised EU answer.

pricing.title: Priced per entity. Never per seat.
pricing.subheadline: Invite the whole agency, the client's marketing lead and their external counsel. Compliance breaks when people are locked out of it.
pricing.footnote1: All prices exclude VAT · charged automatically per member state
pricing.footnote3: Cancel or export your register at any time

trust.title: Infrastructure you can put in front of a regulator.
trust.subheadline: Custodia holds the evidence of your compliance. It is built to the standard that implies.

assessment.title: Find out where you stand before someone else does.
assessment.subheadline: Answer 38 questions mapped to the Regulation and receive a scored report with prioritised remediation. Free, permanently — no card, no call, and the report is yours whether or not you continue.
assessment.usedBy: Used by agencies and their clients across the EU
